notes:
FC-01 OPERATOR OVERRIDE corpus, program 2 of 8 (Hammurabi, BASIC).
ADAPTATION / DOCUMENTED UNSUPPORTED-FEATURE CHANGES (removal/substitution list):
(1) TAB(32)/TAB(15) banner (BASIC 10/20) DROPPED - no counted PUT; EDIT-00 measures
the counted-SKIP refusal. (2) Line 217 IN-YEAR report DROPPED (declared; it printed
the prior year's D and I). (3) CHR(7) bells at 990 DROPPED (10x PRINT CHR$(7); has no
PL/I-80 console bell path). (4) APOSTROPHE REWRITE: 'REALLY WASN'T' -> 'REALLY WAS NOT'
(no doubled-quote literal in this port). (5) BASIC INPUT replaced by console GET LIST
of a fixed 46-value script; README section 7 'pure-PUT' perimeter is the E2E-50/P2 record,
SUPERSEDED for FC-01 by the harness console_input support; consumed ^Z echoes as '^Z'
plus \r\r\n (hop-start re-measurement), unconsumed trailing ^Z never captured.
(6) RNG RND(1) replaced by the DECLARED integer draw gg=gg+1; w=gg*37+11; v=w-(w/k)*k
with seed gg=2; plague fires ~40% not 15% (k=10 residue, declared); rats fire EVERY
year (c=2 residue; 'not year 1' FALSIFIED as unachievable under the 5-draw cadence).
(7) Scaled opening pot P=95,S=1500,H=900,Y=3,A=300(=H/Y),I=5,Q=1: year-1 report prints
a NEGATIVE rat figure E=H-S=-600 (declared; %10d prints the sign). (8) P1, L and 965's
count take the INTEGER FIXED route (BASIC float); reference asserts |float-int|<2 per
year and the nested-floor births identity floor(floor(x/p)/100)+1 == x//(100p)+1 at every
observed (x,p). (9) Weak tests are strict-compare shift forms (t=x+1; a<t; plague t1=q+4>4;
negative t1=x+20000<20000 - every fed value <=1588<=12767 keeps the shift in bin15);
COND.GE_LE is REFUSED by my compiler, strict compares only. (10) VARIABLE divisors at
births x/p, P1 d*100/p and /z, l=a/p - FIRST corpus use, run-unwitnessed; a lane-B FAIL
stays classified, never laundered. (11) Rats site dispatches c=2->s/2, c=4->s/4 (literal
divisors; parity equivalence with BASIC INT(S/C) asserted). (12) Dead stores C=0 (331/350)
and C=1 (430) KEPT as upstream behaviour. (13) z increments AFTER the report (BASIC 215),
qq (last accepted FEED) preserved for 540; 880..896 ladder uses +100 offsets (exhaustive
equivalence asserted). (14) 862/970 and the two 72-col ner: literals split into adjacent
literal items of one PUT LIST (seam = one space under either separator reading; compile
of literal-literal adjacency UNVERIFIED, PROPOSED). (15) goto-in-IF, the c=2/4 dispatch,
the variable divisions and adjacent-literal PUT are FIRST lane-B use (unwitnessed shapes).
Framing [C352]: leading blank line from the first bare PUT SKIP; exit appends one CRLF ->
trailing blank. 211 normalized lines; 46 GET values, max 1588; verdict not-too-bad,
P1=7, L=10, D1=41, final store 1928. Derived, never captured (L3).
